usage: prowler [-h] [--version] {aws,azure,gcp,kubernetes,m365,github,googleworkspace,okta,nhn,mongodbatlas,oraclecloud,alibabacloud,cloudflare,openstack,scaleway,stackit,vercel,linode,huaweicloud,e2enetworks,dashboard,iac,image,llm} ...

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --version, -v  show Prowler version

Available Cloud Providers:
  {aws,azure,gcp,kubernetes,m365,github,googleworkspace,okta,iac,llm,image,nhn,mongodbatlas,oraclecloud,alibabacloud,cloudflare,openstack,scaleway,stackit,vercel,linode,huaweicloud,e2enetworks}
    aws                 AWS Provider
    azure               Azure Provider
    gcp                 GCP Provider
    kubernetes          Kubernetes Provider
    m365                Microsoft 365 Provider
    github              GitHub Provider
    googleworkspace     Google Workspace Provider
    okta                Okta Provider
    cloudflare          Cloudflare Provider
    oraclecloud         Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Provider
    openstack           OpenStack Provider
    stackit             StackIT Provider
    alibabacloud        Alibaba Cloud Provider
    iac                 IaC Provider
    llm                 LLM Provider (Beta)
    image               Container Image Provider
    nhn                 NHN Provider (Unofficial)
    mongodbatlas        MongoDB Atlas Provider
    scaleway            Scaleway Provider
    vercel              Vercel Provider
    linode              Linode Provider
    huaweicloud         Huawei Cloud Provider
    e2enetworks         E2E Networks Provider

Available components:
    dashboard           Local dashboard

To see the different available options on a specific component, run:
    prowler {provider|dashboard} -h|--help

Detailed documentation at https://docs.prowler.com

--account-id.help: Filter scan to specific Cloudflare account IDs. Only zones belonging to these accounts will be scanned.

--alias.help: Optional alias for the provider and scan

--atlas-project-id.help: MongoDB Atlas Project ID to filter scans to a specific project

--aws-retries-max-attempts.help: Set the maximum attemps for the Boto3 standard retrier config (Default: 3)

--aws_profile.help: The name of credential profile to use

--az-cli-auth.help: Use Azure CLI credentials to log in against Azure

--azure-region.help: Azure region from `az cloud list --output table`, by default AzureCloud

--azure-resource-groups.help: Azure Resource Group names to scope the scan to specific groups.

--batch.help: The batch size for bulk creation.

--browser-auth.help: Use browser authentication to log in against Azure, --tenant-id is required for this option

--categories.help: List of categories to be executed.

--certificate-auth.help: Use Certificate authentication to log in against Microsoft 365

--certificate-path.help: Path to the certificate file to be used with --certificate-auth option

--checks.help: List of checks to be executed.

--checks-file.help: JSON file containing the checks to be executed. See config/checklist_example.json

--checks-folder.help: Specify external directory with custom checks (each check must have a folder with the required files, see more in https://docs.prowler.com/user-guide/cli/tutorials/misc#custom-checks-in-prowler).

--cloud.help: Scan every region of a Huawei Cloud instance (international, europe, or china) without listing regions. Also selects the matching endpoint (.eu for europe, .com otherwise). Overridden by --region. Defaults to the HUAWEICLOUD_CLOUD environment variable.

--clouds-yaml-cloud.help: Cloud name from clouds.yaml to use for authentication. Required when using --clouds-yaml-file or when searching for clouds.yaml in standard locations

--clouds-yaml-file.help: Path to clouds.yaml configuration file. If not specified, standard locations will be searched (~/.config/openstack/clouds.yaml, /etc/openstack/clouds.yaml, ./clouds.yaml)

--cluster-name.help: Manually specify the cluster name in in-cluster mode, by default it will be 'in-cluster'

--compartment-id.help: OCI compartment OCIDs to audit. If not specified, all compartments in the tenancy will be audited

--compliance.help: Compliance Framework to check against for. The format should be the following: framework_version_provider (e.g.: cis_3.0_aws)

--context.help: The name of the kubeconfig context to use. By default, current_context from config file will be used.

--credentials-file.help: Authenticate using a Google Service Account Application Credentials JSON file

--credentials-uri.help: URI to retrieve credentials from an external service. The URI must return credentials in the required JSON format. Can also use ALIBABA_CLOUD_CREDENTIALS_URI environment variable

--custom-checks-metadata-file.help: Path for the custom checks metadata YAML file. See example prowler/config/custom_checks_metadata_example.yaml for reference and format. See more in https://docs.prowler.com/user-guide/cli/tutorials/custom-checks-metadata/

--database.help: Specifies the database to operate on.

--dry-run.help: Detect and report orphans without revoking or re-enqueuing.

--e2e-networks-api-key.help: E2E Networks API key. Use E2E_NETWORKS_API_KEY env var instead of passing directly.

--e2e-networks-auth-token.help: E2E Networks auth token. Use E2E_NETWORKS_AUTH_TOKEN env var instead of passing directly.

--e2e-networks-project-id.help: E2E Networks project ID. Use E2E_NETWORKS_PROJECT_ID env var instead of passing directly.

--ecs-ram-role.help: Name of the RAM role attached to an ECS instance. When specified, credentials are obtained from the ECS instance metadata service. Can also use ALIBABA_CLOUD_ECS_METADATA environment variable

--exclude-path.help: Space-separated list of paths to exclude from the scan. Default: none

--exclude-workflows.help: Workflow files or glob patterns to exclude from GitHub Actions scanning

--excluded-checks-file.help: JSON file containing the checks to be excluded. See config/checklist_example.json

--excluded-project-ids.help: Excluded GCP Project IDs to be scanned by Prowler

--excluded-regions.help: AWS region names to exclude from the scan. Overrides the PROWLER_AWS_DISALLOWED_REGIONS environment variable when set.

--external-id.help: External ID to be passed when assuming role

--filter-region.help: Alibaba Cloud region IDs to run Prowler against (e.g., cn-hangzhou, cn-shanghai)

--findings.help: The number of findings to create.

--fixer.help: Fix the failed findings that can be fixed by Prowler

--gcp-retries-max-attempts.help: Set the maximum attempts for the Google Cloud SDK retry config (Default: 3)

--github-app-id.help: GitHub App ID to log in against GitHub

--github-app-key-path.help: GitHub App Key Path to log in against GitHub

--github-username.help: GitHub username for authenticated repository cloning (used with --personal-access-token). If not provided, will use GITHUB_USERNAME env var.

--grace-minutes.help: Skip tasks started within this window (worker may still register).

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--host.help: Host to bind to for HTTP transport (default: 127.0.0.1)

--ignore-exit-code-3.help: Failed checks do not trigger exit code 3

--image.help: Container image to scan. Can be specified multiple times. Examples: nginx:latest, alpine:3.18, myregistry.io/myapp:v1.0

--image-config-scanners.help: Trivy image config scanners (scans Dockerfile-level metadata). Available: misconfig, secret

--image-filter.help: Regex to filter repository names during registry enumeration (re.search). Example: '^prod/.*'

--image-list.help: Path to a file containing list of images to scan (one per line). Lines starting with # are treated as comments.

--kubeconfig-file.help: Path to the kubeconfig file to use for CLI requests. Not necessary for in-cluster execution.

--list-checks-json.help: Output a list of checks in json format to use with --checks-file option

--list-compliance-requirements.help: List requirements and checks per compliance framework

--list-project-ids.help: List available project IDs in Google Cloud which can be scanned by Prowler

--list-remediations.help: List fixers available for the provider

--list-resource-groups.help: List the available check's resource groups

--list-services.help: List covered services by given provider

--managed-identity-auth.help: Use managed identity authentication to log in against Azure

--max-attempts.help: Give up re-running a task after this many recovery attempts; it is then left terminal instead of re-enqueued.

--max-concurrency.help: Maximum number of concurrent requests. Default: 10

--max-images.help: Maximum number of images to scan from registry. 0 = unlimited. Aborts if exceeded.

--mfa.help: IAM entity enforces MFA so you need to input the MFA ARN and the TOTP

--mutelist-file.help: Path for mutelist YAML file. See example prowler/config/<provider>_mutelist.yaml for reference and format. For AWS provider, it also accepts AWS DynamoDB Table, Lambda ARNs or S3 URIs, see more in https://docs.prowler.com/user-guide/cli/tutorials/mutelist

--namespaces.help: The namespaces where to scan for the Kubernetes resources. By default, Prowler will scan all namespaces available.

--no-api.help: Skip the GitHub API and resolve PRs from commit subjects only

--no-github-actions.help: Disable GitHub Actions workflow security scanning

--oauth-app-token.help: OAuth App Token to log in against GitHub

--oidc-role-arn.help: ARN of the RAM role for OIDC authentication. Requires OIDC provider ARN and token file to be set via environment variables (ALIBABA_CLOUD_OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN and ALIBABA_CLOUD_OIDC_TOKEN_FILE). Can also use ALIBABA_CLOUD_ROLE_ARN environment variable

--okta-client-id.help: Okta service app Client ID for OAuth 2.0 (private-key JWT)

--okta-org-domain.help: Okta organization domain (e.g. acme.okta.com). Must be an Okta-managed domain (.okta.com / .oktapreview.com / .okta-emea.com / .okta-gov.com / .okta.mil / .okta-miltest.com / .trex-govcloud.com), without scheme or path.

--okta-requests-per-second.help: Maximum aggregate Okta API requests per second. Throttles requests to stay under Okta's rate limits. Overrides the config.yaml value (okta_requests_per_second); set to 0 to disable. Default: 4.

--okta-retries-max-attempts.help: Maximum number of retries on Okta API rate limiting (HTTP 429). Overrides the config.yaml value (okta_max_retries). Default: 5.

--okta-scopes.help: OAuth scopes to request, space-separated (e.g. okta.policies.read okta.brands.read okta.apps.read okta.logStreams.read okta.idps.read). Defaults to the read scopes required by the bundled checks.

--only-logs.help: Print only Prowler logs by the stdout. This option sets --no-banner.

--organization-id.help: GCP Organization ID to be scanned by Prowler

--organizations.help: Organization or user name(s) to scan repositories for

--organizations-role.help: Specify AWS Organizations management role ARN to be assumed, to get Organization metadata

--os-auth-url.help: OpenStack authentication URL (Keystone endpoint). Can also be set via OS_AUTH_URL environment variable

--os-identity-api-version.help: OpenStack Identity API version (2 or 3). Can also be set via OS_IDENTITY_API_VERSION environment variable

--os-password.help: OpenStack password for authentication. Can also be set via OS_PASSWORD environment variable

--os-project-domain-name.help: OpenStack project domain name. Can also be set via OS_PROJECT_DOMAIN_NAME environment variable

--os-project-id.help: OpenStack project ID (tenant ID). Can also be set via OS_PROJECT_ID environment variable

--os-region-name.help: OpenStack region name. Can also be set via OS_REGION_NAME environment variable

--os-user-domain-name.help: OpenStack user domain name. Can also be set via OS_USER_DOMAIN_NAME environment variable

--os-username.help: OpenStack username for authentication. Can also be set via OS_USERNAME environment variable

--output-bucket.help: Custom output bucket, requires -M <mode> and it can work also with -o flag.

--output-bucket-no-assume.help: Same as -B but do not use the assumed role credentials to put objects to the bucket, instead uses the initial credentials.

--output-directory.help: Custom output directory, by default the folder where Prowler is stored

--output-filename.help: Custom output report name without the file extension, if not specified will use default output/prowler-output-ACCOUNT_NUM-OUTPUT_DATE.format

--output-formats.help: Output modes, by default csv and json-oscf are saved. When using AWS Security Hub integration, json-asff output is also saved.

--personal-access-token.help: Personal Access Token to log in against GitHub

--port.help: Port to bind to for HTTP transport (default: 8000)

--profile.help: AWS profile to launch prowler with

--project-id.help: Default Scaleway project ID for project-scoped resources.

--project-ids.help: GCP Project IDs to be scanned by Prowler

--projects.help: Filter scan to specific Vercel project names or IDs.

--provider-uid.help: Unique identifier for the IaC provider. Required when using --push-to-cloud.

--push-to-cloud.help: Send findings in OCSF format to Prowler Cloud. Requires PROWLER_CLOUD_API_KEY environment variable. For the IaC provider, --provider-uid is also required. More details here: https://goto.prowler.com/import-findings

--quick-inventory.help: Run Prowler Quick Inventory. The inventory will be stored in an output csv by default

--region.help: Microsoft 365 region to be used, default is M365Global

--registry.help: Registry URL to enumerate and scan all images. Examples: myregistry.io, docker.io/myorg, 123456789.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com

--registry-insecure.help: Skip TLS verification for registry connections (for self-signed certificates).

--registry-list.help: List all repositories and tags from the registry, then exit without scanning. Useful for discovering available images before building --image-filter or --tag-filter.

--repo-list-file.help: Path to a file containing a list of repositories to scan (one per line in 'owner/repo-name' format). Lines starting with # are treated as comments.

--repositories.help: Repository name(s) to scan in 'owner/repo-name' format

--resource-arns.help: Scan only resources with specific AWS Resource ARNs, e.g., arn:aws:iam::012345678910:user/test arn:aws:ec2:us-east-1:123456789012:vpc/vpc-12345678

--resource-groups.help: List of resource groups to be executed.

--resource-tags.help: Scan only resources with specific AWS Tags (Key=Value), e.g., Environment=dev Project=prowler

--resources.help: The number of resources to create.

--role.help: ARN of the role to be assumed

--role-arn.help: ARN of the RAM role to assume (e.g., acs:ram::123456789012:role/ProwlerAuditRole). Requires access keys to be set via environment variables (ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID and ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET). The provider will automatically obtain and refresh STS tokens. Can also use ALIBABA_CLOUD_ROLE_ARN environment variable

--role-session-name.help: Session name when assuming the RAM role. Defaults to ProwlerAssessmentSession. Can also use ALIBABA_CLOUD_ROLE_SESSION_NAME environment variable

--scan-path.help: Path to the folder containing your infrastructure-as-code files. Default: current directory. Mutually exclusive with --scan-repository-url.

--scan-repository-url.help: URL to the repository containing your infrastructure-as-code files. Mutually exclusive with --scan-path.

--scan-secrets-validate.help: Validate secrets discovered by the secrets checks by checking whether they are live against the provider APIs. WARNING: this makes outbound network calls using the discovered secret itself; the credential is exercised against the provider and the call appears in the audited account's logs. Disabled by default.

--scanners.help: Space-separated list of scanners to scan. Default: misconfig secret

--security-hub.help: Send check output to AWS Security Hub and save json-asff output.

--send-sh-only-fails.help: Send only Prowler failed findings to SecurityHub

--services.help: List of services to be executed.

--session-duration.help: Assumed role session duration in seconds, must be between 900 and 43200. Default: 3600

--shodan.help: Check if any public IPs in your Cloud environments are exposed in Shodan. We recommend to use the SHODAN_API_KEY environment variable to provide the API key.

--skip-api-check.help: Assume all APIs are active and skip the active API check for each service

--skip-sh-update.help: Skip updating previous findings of Prowler in Security Hub

--skip_on_error.help: If check output is invalid json, error out instead of skipping the check

--slack.help: Send a summary of the execution with a Slack APP in your channel. Environment variables SLACK_API_TOKEN and SLACK_CHANNEL_NAME are required (see more in https://docs.prowler.com/user-guide/cli/tutorials/integrations#configuration-of-the-integration-with-slack/).

--stackit-project-id.help: StackIT Project ID to audit (alternatively set via STACKIT_PROJECT_ID environment variable)

--stackit-region.help: STACKIT region(s) to scan (default: all available regions)

--stackit-service-account-key.help: Inline content of a StackIT service account key (JSON). Useful in CI/CD where the secret comes from a secret manager and you do not want to write it to disk. Prefer the STACKIT_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable over this flag to avoid leaking the key through process listings or shell history.

--stackit-service-account-key-path.help: Path to a StackIT service account key JSON file. The SDK signs the RSA challenge in the key and mints/refreshes access tokens internally for the life of the scan. Alternatively set via the STACKIT_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH environment variable.

--subscription-ids.help: Azure Subscription IDs to be scanned by Prowler

--tag-filter.help: Regex to filter tags during registry enumeration (re.search). Example: '^(latest|v\d+\.\d+\.\d+)$'

--tenant.help: Tenant id for which the data will be populated.

--tenant-id.help: Azure Tenant ID to be used with --browser-auth option

--trivy-severity.help: Filter Trivy findings by severity. Default: all severities. Available: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, UNKNOWN

--unix-timestamp.help: Set the output timestamp format as unix timestamps instead of iso format timestamps (default mode).

--use-instance-principal.help: Use OCI Instance Principal authentication (only works when running inside an OCI compute instance)

--verbose.help: Runs showing all checks executed and results
